title: Contest FAQ
intro: Weekly club contests were introduced on May 29, 2019, allowing clubs to compete for exclusive statue decorations. Special coat competitions were introduced in February 2021 as bi-weekly contests and shifted to weekly contests in May 2026. A new contest week begins every Wednesday around 10:25 AM CEST.
description_p1: Each Wednesday, the game generates a new selection of 4 contest options: three statue contests and one Special Coat contest.
description_p2: Presidents and ministers may open a contest any time during the week. A guild may only enter one contest for the week. Once a contest has been selected, there is no way to undo the action, so choose carefully.
description_p3: Club members can participate in the chosen contest by opening the contest tab inside the clubhouse screen. Tap "Donate Cards" to open the donation screen. Members can donate their corresponding animal cards from inventory (if any) or purchase level 1 animal cards with coins or diamonds (depending on the animal) on the donation screen. Animal cards can be obtained from breeding or purchasing more of the animal. There is no donation limit.
description_p4: Club members can donate any level, age, gender, or color of animal as long as it matches the current contest species. Color and gender have no effect on points.
new_members_body: As of November 2023, new club members must wait seven days in order to donate to fundraisers and contests, but they can still immediately benefit from activated club fundraisers and contest rewards. This measure was highly requested by the community to prevent certain cheating.
donation_intro: Donating animal cards gives two types of points: Contest Points and Membership Experience Points.
contest_points_body: Contest points contribute to the overall club score for the weekly contest's final score. Only the animal level matters — the color and maturity of the animal do not affect the calculation of contest points. Level 1 (whether purchased or from inventory) is worth 10 points towards the weekly contest.
member_points_body: Member points add to the player's personal club membership rank points, which unlock items for purchase inside the Club Shop and give the member a new rank title. Member point earnings are equivalent to half the donated animal's popularity points (rounded down to the nearest whole number). Note that babies are twice as popular as adults, which means babies give twice the personal member points as adults.
rank_bonus_intro: There is a bonus multiplier depending on the member's ranking from donations to the contest that week. This ranking is determined by each player's total weekly contribution. The overall Guild Weekly Score is calculated by multiplying each player's points by their rank bonus, then adding those totals together.
rewards_body: Every club that enters a weekly contest receives rewards based on their final ranking position in their selected contest. The club itself receives rank-based experience points, and every club member receives puzzle pieces regardless of their participation level.
